text:
## Top stories

- Anthropic is aiming for a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion in its upcoming stock market flotation, marking a significant milestone despite recent cooling investor interest in the AI sector [The Guardian Business, The Verge AI]. The company's IPO is expected to be one of the largest in history, with shares projected to be priced between $70 and $78.
- The United Arab Emirates has imposed a travel ban on former IGP Benazir Ahmed, while the Bangladesh government confirms that diplomatic and legal efforts to bring him back remain ongoing [bdnews24.com, Bangladesh Sangbad Sangstha (BSS)]. Home Minister and other officials emphasized that the extradition process is complex and not an easy procedure [Daily Observer, dhakapost.com].
- A major law firm, Crosby, has purchased malpractice insurance for its AI agents, highlighting an emerging insurance gap as firms increasingly integrate artificial intelligence into legal practice [NYT Business]. Meanwhile, eBay has reportedly blocked third-party AI agents, such as Meta’s Muse, from browsing its platform [The Verge AI].
- Google has released its "strongest model" yet, Gemini 4 Carbon, which features new "swarm" agent capabilities and is designed to compete directly with leading systems from OpenAI and Anthropic [The Verge AI, Hacker News]. Additionally, Google has expanded its hardware portfolio with new specialized tensor processing units (TPUs) for confidential model training [TechCrunch AI].
- Global oil prices have seen a sharp decline, tumbling by more than $20 a barrel since late October, while the U.S. Federal Reserve remains under pressure to raise interest rates due to elevated inflation [NYT Business].

## AI

- Meta’s AI agent, Muse, is now available for interaction via voice and text on Apple Watch and Android Wear OS [TechCrunch AI].
- Google’s DeepMind has revealed Gemini Robotics 2.5 and an open-source safety benchmark called "ASIMOV-jailbreak" [Ars Technica].
- Research indicates that approximately 64% of people in Bangladesh are unaware of AI technology, with a significant portion of those who are aware having never used it [প্রথম আলো].

## Business

- Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe has declared 2027 an "inflection year" for the EV maker as it scales production of its R2 SUV and invests heavily in autonomy [CNBC Business].
- Flying cars could begin operation in China as early as next summer, with a two-seat autopilot model currently being prepared for emergency and recreational use [The Guardian Business].
- A California ballot initiative to tax billionaires failed, serving as a setback for progressive economic agendas in the United States [NYT Business].

## Tech

- Blender 5.3 has been released, featuring new support for Gaussian Splats [Hacker News].
- .NET 11 has been officially announced by Microsoft [Hacker News].
- The U.S. is reportedly struggling to retain young scientific talent due to concerns over funding cuts and research support [Hacker News].

## Bangladesh

- The government has placed strict spending limits on ministries, banning new vehicle purchases and certain building constructions while requiring revised budget proposals by November 26 [প্রথম আলো].
- Jamaat MP told parliament that residents in Khulna are living in fear due to rising extortion and killings, while opposition leaders questioned the Home Ministry's ability to manage law and order [The Daily Star, প্রথম আলো].
- Bangladesh’s hilsa fish production has seen a 26% decline over the past five years, dropping to an estimated 4.20 lakh tonnes in FY2025-26 [The Daily Star].
- Bangladesh Bank has rebranded its small-loan scheme to "e-Loan," supported by a Tk 100 crore revolving fund [The Daily Star].

## Education & Admission

- The National University has launched a specialized ICT training program for 90 core trainers to enhance digital literacy [Daily Sun].
- The Ministry of Education and Training is reviewing the admission process for specialized high schools to ensure student rights are protected [Vietnam.vn].

## Scholarships

- The Commonwealth Shared Scholarships 2027/2028 are open for fully funded Master’s study in the United Kingdom [Opportunities For Africans].
- Applications are open for the Wave Winter Research Fellowship 2026-2027, an 8-week incubator for scientific research, with a deadline of November 13, 2026 [Opportunity Desk].
- The Career Pathways Initiative Fellowship 2027 is accepting applications for first-generation, low-income undergraduate students until January 29, 2027 [Opportunity Desk].

## What to watch

- Watch for further developments regarding the extradition of former government officials and the ongoing legal debate surrounding Sheikh Hasina's NID status and potential return [dhakapost.com, BBC].
- Monitor international reactions to the trilateral peace talks in the UAE between Kyiv, Washington, and Moscow [BBC World].
